title: Silvi Materials to develop cement import terminal in North Carolina
summary: Silvi Materials to develop cement import terminal in North Carolina
body_markdown:
**US:** Silvi Materials will develop an upcoming cement import terminal at the Port of Wilmington in North Carolina, following acceptance of its proposal by the North Carolina State Ports Authority on 16 November 2026. The terminal will feature a 100,000t storage dome, two rail loadouts and four truck loadouts.


The terminal will connect to the CSX rail network and complement Silvi Materials’ upcoming cement import terminal at the Port of Morehead City in North Carolina, which will feature two 100,000t storage domes and connect to the Norfolk Southern rail network.


Brain Clark, Executive Director of North Carolina Ports, said “This project will enhance the region’s access to essential construction materials, helping support continued growth and development across North Carolina.”
